title: CppCon 2017: Louis Brandy “Curiously Recurring C++ Bugs at Facebook”
summary: Louis Brandy presents the most common and infamous recurring C++ bugs seen in Facebook's huge codebase, including shared_ptr data races and operator[] pitfalls. He explains the surprising complexity behind seemingly simple code.
why: HN recommends it as a must-watch catalogue of C++ footguns, often cited in debates about Rust and C++ safety.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: is a great video that covers a lot of good stuff in particular this usability bug. It's worth watching in its entirety.
